I wrote the review to `.social-review.md` with the X and LinkedIn copy failing and Bluesky passing. I didn't post a PR comment. I also didn't run the critique or suggestions sub-agents that SKILL.md calls for. I checked the copy against the rubric myself and counted characters with Python.

- **X — FAIL:** It ends with the hashtag `#AIAgents`. The suggested copy drops it and changes nothing else (178/255 characters).
- **LinkedIn — FAIL:** It opens in "I" voice ("I have watched this happen on every team I have worked with"). The suggested copy removes that sentence.
  - I also replaced "a few hundred thousand lines" with "a large codebase", because that figure isn't in the blog post.
  - The suggested copy is 416/2950 characters.
- **Bluesky — PASS:** Two paragraphs, 182/300 characters, and no rule breaks.

I left out the advisory suggestions section because I had no style notes for Bluesky.

The file also carries the required opening marker, the orienting note, the collapsed suggested-copy block and the commit footer. Because these are CI runs, I added the "apply these suggestions" and "re-run" lines from SKILL.md's CI section.
